_comment: Reference only — realm roles are not part of the addon integration contract and are not imported automatically. Create it in the Keycloak Admin UI (Realm roles -> Create role) or POST this body to /admin/realms/papaia/roles, then assign it to the operators allowed to drive ingestion from LibreChat. Must match QI_OIDC_OPERATOR_ROLE. Without it every MCP call is rejected with 403 missing_operator_role.
name: qdrant-ingest-operator
description: Operator for the Qdrant ingestion service — holders may list jobs, inspect runs, and trigger reindexing over MCP
